The Sentencing Process Guideline
Scottish Sentencing Council report on public consultation exercise

98. A number of respondents took this opportunity. Some at this point wondered about
the guideline’s use of “offender”, a point which has been addressed elsewhere in
this report.

99. One respondent asked whether the guideline was capable of being changed. The
legislation under which the Council operates provides a mechanism for guideline
revision, should the Council deem it appropriate at any future stage. (Any revision
requires to be approved by the High Court.) On top of that, the Council is required
by law to review its guidelines from time to time.
